spans.s:
m. (-ङ्गुः)
The personified ascending node^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

Gold.
2

Semen.
3

A cowry.
E.
हृ to take, ल्युट् aff., and इ substituted for the antepen. vowel: see हिरण्य.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of gold, golden.
m. (-यः)
BRAHMĀ.
n. (-यं)
One of the Varṣas or divisions of the continent; the part between the mountainous ranges Śveta and Śṛṅgavān.
E.
हिरण् for हिरण gold, मयट् aff.

Gold.
2

Either of the precious metals, crude bullion, unwrought gold or silver.
3 Silver, crude or wrought.
4 A measure.
5 A cowry.
6 Semen virile.
7 Imperishable matter, that which is eternal.
8 Thing, substance.
9 Wealth, property.
E.
हृ to take, Uṇādi aff. कन्यन्, and किरच् substituted for the radical letters.

m. (-पुः)
A Daitya, the father of PRAHLĀDA, for whose destruction, VIṢṆU descended in the fourth or NARASIṂHA Avatāra.
E.
हिरण्य gold, and कशिपु clothing, or food and clothing.

m. (-हा)
VIṢṆU.
E.
हिरण्यकशिपु a Daitya, and हन् destroyer.

m. (-र्भः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
हिरण्य gold, गर्भं embryo; or the mundane egg floating on the water at creation, of that metal, or of similar colour, from which the deity issued, according to some legends.

m. (-दः)
The ocean.
f. (-दा)
The earth.
E.
हिरण्य gold, and द what gives or yields.

m. (-भः)
The mountain Maināka.
E.
हिरण्य gold, नाम navel.

m. (-हुः)
1 The river Śoṇa.
2 ŚIVA.
E.
हिरण्य golden, बाहु an arm.

Fire.
2

The sun.
3 ŚIVA.
E.
हिरण्य gold, and रेतस् semen.

m. (-वः)
A divine treasure.
E.
हिरण्य gold, व possessive aff. in this sense.

f. (-र्णा)
A river in general.
E.
हिरण्य gold, and वर्ण colour.

m. (-हः)
The river Śoṇa.
E.
हिरण्य gold, वह to bear, aff. अण्.

m. (-क्षः)
The name of a demon, killed by VIṢṆU.
E.
हिरण्य, and अक्ष for अक्षि eye.

ind.
1 Without, except.
2 In the midst of, amongst.
3 Near.
E.
हि to go, रुकक् aff.

IVA.
2

INDRA'S thunderbolt.
3 A snake.
4 A necklace.
5 A lion.
n. (-रं)
A diamond.
f. (-रा)
1 The goddess LAKṢMĪ.
2 A cockroach.
3 An ant.
E.
हृ to take, क aff., and ईरु substituted for the radical finals.

m. (-कः)
The diamond.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The thunderbolt of INDRA.
E.
हीर the diamond, and अङ्ग substance; being supposed to be the same.
